$comment: Project probes for the global bg-status skill (/bg-status). Read-only: loopback HTTP GETs, regex matches over the host process list, Docker container states and file stats. Nothing in this file runs a command.

http.name: Localization authority shadow scan and auto-drive

sql.name: active jobs
sql.query: select id, job_type, status, current_phase, date_trunc('second', now() - coalesce(started_at, enqueued_at, created_at)) as age from jobs where status in ('queued', 'running', 'paused') order by id desc limit 10

sql.name: phases running over 1 h
sql.query: select count(*) as stale_running from image_phase_status where status = 'running' and started_at < now() - interval '1 hour'

sql.name: Postgres queries running over 60 s
sql.query: select pid, coalesce(nullif(application_name, ''), '-') as app, state, date_trunc('second', now() - query_start) as age, left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 80) as query from pg_stat_activity where datname = current_database() and pid <> pg_backend_pid() and state <> 'idle' and query_start < now() - interval '60 seconds' order by query_start limit 10

notes: D:/Projects/image-scoring-pipeline is a junction to image-scoring-backend: tasks from sessions started in either folder are listed.
A quiet watch loop on the shadow scan is healthy while localization_authority.scan_cursor keeps rising between snapshots.
Processes inside the containers, active jobs and long Postgres queries show only with --exec-probes (read-only docker exec, 5 s each).
Container GPU use shows on the host only as vmmemWSL; nvidia-smi on Windows can't attribute it to a process.
The image-scoring-* containers are shared by every local session: ask the peers (ListAgents, SendMessage) before `docker compose stop`.
